proposal: Require a timestamped current price, explicit base/bear/bull valuation scenarios and downside before any security thesis becomes decision-grade.
title: Security readiness requires current price and scenarios

proposal: Before candidate or simulation admission, separate recurring operating earnings and cash conversion from headline growth and explicitly test the expectations embedded in valuation.
title: AI infrastructure requires recurring cash and expectations decomposition

proposal: Separate core infrastructure cash earnings from investment income, hydrology or cyclical effects and verify payout coverage before candidate admission.
title: Infrastructure requires core earnings and payout separation

proposal: Require recurring earnings confirmation, free-cash-flow reconciliation, current valuation and explicit portfolio-role comparison before candidate admission.
title: Quality compounders require core earnings and portfolio fit

proposal: Any strategy-rule change requires multiple independent observations, explicit failure classification, regression testing and human approval; one stock or one period is insufficient.
title: No single-period outcome may change system rules
